messages.subject: Mosaic - report on title, points for the client
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft report on title done (saved to the matter folder). The title is clean - single Clydesford charge to be discharged, the Thames Water sewer easement, and the eight leases. Two things to flag to Daniel: (1) the Unit 1 break in June 2027 drives the WAULT to first break down to 4.9 years; and (2) the Unit 4 review is still open. Local search is the only outstanding item before we can recommend exchange.

Elena's running the apportionments - completion balance is coming out around £19.02m before SDLT.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
DDI +44 (0)20 7946 0531
